articles.title: Pikachu Plush Visits the Space Station
articles.summary: A Pikachu plush spent 67 days on the International Space Station. ESA is celebrating World Space Week with a space science exhibit and Pokémon GO activities in Europe.

articles.title: Djokovic Comes Back to Win in Beijing
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic came back after losing the first set to beat Bu Yunchaokete at the China Open. Aryna Sabalenka also won her opening match.

articles.title: Giant Recycled Table Sets World Record
articles.summary: About 20,000 people gathered at a record-setting recycled table in Romania. The meal raised more than $110,000 for a new children's mental health hospital.
